Add a retry wrapper around the release lookup so that transient network failures no longer abort the whole announcement flow for users with large repositories.
Refactor the draft scheduler to read channel limits from a single table, which removes three duplicated constants and makes it easier to add a new network later on.
Fix the card renderer so that long project names wrap correctly instead of overflowing the frame, and add a regression test covering names longer than sixty characters.
Update the onboarding flow to explain which permissions are requested from Buffer and why, because several early testers were unsure what the connection would be allowed to do.
Remove the unused feature flag for the old queue and delete the migration helpers that only existed to support it. This should not change any behaviour for existing accounts.
Document the environment variables needed to run the API locally, including the optional ones, and describe how the fake services are wired up for the test suite.
